description: Semantic completion for trusted protocols whose reviewed practical content no longer maps cleanly from the legacy Growth Zone. These mappings describe the effective public protocol, not the historical collection label.

build-your-support-network.reason: The effective protocol maps a concrete need to an appropriate person or resource, makes a bounded request, and preserves consent and relationship boundaries. Relationships is the primary Topic; Clear Communication covers the explicit request and correction step.

break-down-big-problems-triz.reason: The effective protocol frames a hard problem as a contradiction, generates separation or redesign options, and checks a reversible change. Problem Solving and Creative Problem Solving describe the task; TRIZ is the explicit Method.

attention-to-detail-trainer.reason: The effective protocol converts known failure modes into a repeatable artifact-verification loop and updates the checklist from real misses. Error Prevention is primary; Work Systems captures the recurring review process.

break-big-goals-into-steps.reason: The effective protocol defines a finish condition, exposes dependencies, decomposes work into observable deliverables, and chooses the next useful step. Goals and Planning & Prioritization are the concrete Topics.

phase-transition-ritual-tracker.reason: The reviewed protocol is an operational handoff between activities: preserve unfinished state, make one visible closing move, and name the first action in the next mode. Work Systems captures the handoff; Attention & Focus captures the context-switching boundary without implying a therapeutic mechanism.

process-of-elimination-tracker.reason: The reviewed protocol narrows a choice by applying defensible constraints, separating unknowns from failures, and comparing only viable survivors. Decision Making is primary; Problem Solving covers the structured elimination and information-gaining step.

qa-clear-feedback-templates.reason: The reviewed protocol turns an observed defect into an actionable QA handoff with reproduction context, redacted evidence, explicit hypotheses, expected behavior, and an acceptance check. Error Prevention covers verification; Clear Communication covers the handoff structure.

if-then-rules-productivity.reason: The reviewed protocol pre-decides a safe response to a recurring low-stakes cue, includes an exception path, and requires revision when the rule stops fitting. Habits & Consistency captures repeatability; Work Systems captures the operational rule and fallback.
